title: Points-Earning Relief on Rush Co-Pay Waivers — Finch Circle and Marlowe & Finch Alterations
content:
Active earners in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program receive a points relief on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations rush co-pay waiver. A points relief raises a co-pay waiver from the Finch Circle points earned in earn entries dated less than 12 whole months before today: by 10 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives for 3000 points or more, by 5 percent for 1500 to 2999 points, and not at all below 1500 points.

| Points earned in earn entries dated less than 12 whole months before today | Points relief |
|---|---|
| 3000 or more | 10 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives |
| 1500 to 2999 | 5 percent of the amount the co-pay form waives |
| below 1500 | none |

**Records read.** The earn entries of the member's Finch Circle points ledger and their dates. Only earn entries enter the total; other kinds of ledger entries do not. An earn entry dated 12 whole months or more before today is outside the count.

## Thresholds, both sides

| Points earned in the window | Relief |
|---|---|
| 1499 | none |
| 1500 | 5 percent |
| 2999 | 5 percent |
| 3000 | 10 percent |

## Hypothetical illustration

A member's earn entries in the window total 1800 points, and an older earn entry of 2000 points is dated more than 12 whole months before today. The count is 1800 points, so a co-pay waiver of 20.00 USD is raised by 5 percent of 20.00 USD, that is 1.00 USD.
